sloka: कुम्भस्य पततो रूपं भग्नस्योरसि मुष्टिना।बभौ रुद्राभिपन्नस्य यथा रूपं गवां पतेः ।। ६.७६.९३ ।।
transliteration: kumbhasya patato rūpaṁ bhagnasyorasi muṣṭinā।babhau rudrābhipannasya yathā rūpaṁ gavāṁ pateḥ ।। 6.76.93 ।।

translations.english: Struck by the fist of Sugriva, the Rakshasa fell just as the glowing planet endowed with brightness accidentally fell from the sky.
